content.body: Paratroopers were elite troops well armed for the assault role they were frequently dropped into, and their tough training gave them extra stamina over their regular infantry counterparts.
content.brief: WEAPON: Thompson M1928 SMG AMMO: .45 cal Auto Colt Pistol (ACP) MAGAZINE: 30 round clip MUZZLE VELOCITY: 280 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Automatic OTHER EQUIPMENT: Webley .455 cal (11.6 mm) Revolver No.36 Mills Bomb HE Grenades (4) No.77 Mk I Smoke Grenades (4) Satchel Charge (1) Combat Knife
content.title: Paratrooper
